history.summary: IDENTITY PROVISIONAL (verify): no 'Chandika Temple, Rampur' exists in sources consulted; this file documents the famous Chandika Devi temple at Kothi (near Reckong Peo/Kalpa), the only major Chandika shrine in the greater Rampur-Bushahr/Kinnaur region. CSV town 'Rampur' is therefore corrected - actual town Kothi, Kalpa tehsil, Kinnaur district, ~50 km from Rampur. The temple is famed as the divine court of justice: local disputes are brought before the goddess, whose decisions are treated as final. She is regarded as Kinnaur's most powerful and richest goddess, the sanctum housing an exquisite gold image; the pagoda-style temple set among deodar groves shows fine Kinnauri wood craftsmanship. If the CSV intends a different Chandika shrine, this mapping must be corrected.

name: Chandika Temple, Rampur
town_description: Kothi is a small village near Reckong Peo in Kinnaur district, Himachal Pradesh, set against deodar groves with views of the Kinner Kailash range. It lies ~3 km from Reckong Peo, the district headquarters. The village is best known for its ancient Chandika Devi temple, a major pilgrimage site for Kinnauris. CSV town 'Rampur' corrected: the temple is at Kothi, Kinnaur district (in the Rampur Bushahr cultural region), not in Rampur town.

travel.road: ~3 km from Reckong Peo on the NH-5 corridor; HRTC buses from Shimla/Rampur to Reckong Peo, then local taxi
